arguments.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS transactions_within_2_minutes FROM (SELECT id, card_id, date, lag(date) OVER (PARTITION BY card_id ORDER BY date, id) AS previous FROM transactions) WHERE previous IS NOT NULL AND strftime('%s', date) - strftime('%s', previous) <= 120
arguments.explanation: Counts transactions whose gap to the previous transaction on the same card is 2 minutes or less. It covers all transactions, labelled or not.
assumptions: 'Within 2 minutes' means a gap of 120 seconds or less between consecutive transactions on the same card.
The first transaction on each card has no previous transaction, so it is not counted.
All transactions are included, whether or not they have a fraud label, and regardless of amount sign or error status.
Transactions on the same timestamp are ordered by id so the previous transaction is deterministic.
The count covers the full data range, 2019-01-01 to 2019-10-31.
